subject: Unexpected quality delta in A/B — proposed mitigation & action map
messages:
From: Sarah Fontaine <sarah@fontaine.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: rollout A/B — baseline slipped after promptset tweak

Hi Hannah,

Quick heads up — we flipped the new prompt normalization (promptset_v2) into A for 20% of traffic last night and we’re seeing a measurable quality drop on a handful of intent buckets (mainly long-form summarization and legal-clause extraction). The delta is ~3.4% drop on our internal F1 metric versus baseline. Latency is unchanged.

I attached a small sample of the promptset and the failing examples (promptset_sample_v2.csv). We’d like to pause the rollout and coordinate a rollback or targeted mitigation. Can your team recommend an acceptance threshold and a fast mitigant?

We’re available to join an ops call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah
--
Sarah Fontaine
Head of Product
Fontaine AI
ops@fontaine.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Fontaine <sarah@fontaine.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: rollout A/B — baseline slipped after promptset tweak

Sarah — thanks for the signal and for sending the sample. I pulled the quick profiler and attached a short note (initial-analysis-20261107.pdf) with the first-cut observations:

- Failure concentrated in prompts > 250 tokens with heavy nested bullets.
- Model variant behaved as expected on throughput; this looks like a prompt-preprocessing mismatch (normalization removed key delimiters for legal extraction).
- Short-term mitigant: re-enable previous normalization on the legal extraction route (can be gated by route).

Proposed immediate plan (short):
1) Pause the variant for the affected route (we can do percent rollback per route in 15m).
2) Run a targeted AB re-eval using your sample set + 500 recent production prompts (we should see F1 recover if it's preprocessing).
3) If recovery < 1% delta, can resume rolling with narrower route set; else roll back globally.

Product asks for this plan to work (Marissa/Karthik):
- Define acceptance: should we use <= 1.0% F1 delta over the sampled prompts and no >2% failure spike in top-50 intents?
- Owner for targeted re-eval and gating policy (who will run the follow-up eval and update the rollout rules in the console?).
- If we need a hotfix to normalization, what SLA for patch on your side vs ours?

I’ve added Marissa and Karthik to help with acceptance criteria and who owns the rollout gates. Happy to jump on a 30m call now if you want — otherwise we can sync async.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sarah Fontaine <sarah@fontaine.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: rollout A/B — baseline slipped after promptset tweak

Thanks — quick product-level guidance from my side:

Acceptance & gating (proposal):
- Primary gate: F1 delta <= 0.8% on the representative sample (your sample + 500 prod).
- Secondary gate: No single intent group among top-100 requested intents should show >1.5% absolute increase in failure rate.
- Latency: tail P99 must not increase by >20ms for the affected routes.

Rollback policy:
- If primary gate fails in targeted re-eval -> immediate route-level rollback to baseline normalization.
- If secondary gate fails but primary passes -> deploy a narrow exception for the problematic intents (route-level bypass).

Operational asks (what we need from Fontaine AI):
- Share the production log slice (anonymized) for the 20% cohort — we need the sample and distribution to validate coverage.
- Assign an exec contact for quick approvals (1-2 people) for any hot rollback in next 24h.

I uploaded a working eval spreadsheet (eval-summary-11-08.xlsx) to the Drive link in related_links and dropped notes under the gating sheet. Karthik — can you confirm runtime feasibility for route-level bypass and the expected time to gate change?

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Fontaine <sarah@fontaine.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: rollout A/B — baseline slipped after promptset tweak

Confirmed — technical notes and next steps:

- Route-level bypass is supported and can be enacted via the console; estimated change window: 10-20 minutes with one operator. We’ll tag the change for rollback auditing.
- I’ll run the targeted re-eval using the shared sample + 500 random recent prompts. Expect results in ~3 hours after I get the production slice (please upload to the Drive folder or send S3 pointer).
- If primary gate fails, I’ll enact route rollback and notify ops+cs. If secondary gate fails only, I’ll implement exception rule for intents flagged in the eval sheet.

Action owners & deadlines:
- Fontaine: upload production slice (ops@fontaine.ai) — ACTION by 11/09 19:00 PST
- Karthik: run re-eval and post results to Drive — ACTION by 11/09 19:30 PST (3 hours after upload)
- Marissa: finalize acceptance thresholds doc and include rollback messaging — ACTION by 11/09 18:00 PST
- Hannah: coordinate exec approvals and confirm go/no-go — ACTION by 11/09 18:30 PST

I’ll put a short status update in the Drive and send a one-line status when rollback is done.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Engineering Manager, Inference Platform — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
